definitions.gloss: applicant; entrant; person who applies or enters
definitions.explanation: A person who responds to a call for applications, such as a job posting, contest, or open call. Emphasizes the act of applying in response to an opportunity.

examples.japanese: {応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{殺到|さっとう}→殺到：15036_sattou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{上|あ}げます→差し上げる：01597_sashiageru⟧。

⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧{応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: More than a hundred entrants gathered for this contest.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧ (application, entry) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers specifically to someone who responds to a public invitation — a job listing, a contest, a campaign, etc.

USAGE:
Very common in business and hiring contexts. Unlike ⟦{志願者|しがんしゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧ (volunteer) or ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧ (candidate), {応募者|おうぼしゃ} emphasizes the responsive nature of the application — someone applied because an opportunity was announced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ — many applicants
- {応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧ — to solicit applicants
- {応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧ — all applicants
- {応募者|おうぼしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ — number of applicants

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧ — candidate, nominee (broader, includes those nominated by others)
- ⟦{志願者|しがんしゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧ — volunteer, someone who puts themselves forward
- {受験者|じゅけんしゃ} — examinee, test-taker (specifically for exams)
